svg.title: Butterfly and complex multiplier internals
svg.desc: B and the twiddle W feed four 23 by 16 multipliers, then an add/subtract stage and a round-and-truncate stage produce t. A is delayed two cycles. Four adders form X = A + t and Y = A - t.
svg.text: → fft_mem write ports: X to A, Y to B
c+1 A, B, W valid at inputs
c+4 X, Y registered at outputs
